scope: Read-only metadata and in-text claim support audit of eight assigned references; no manuscript edits; no Dominici search.

references.metadata: Amro Abbas; Kushal Tirumala; Daniel Simig; Surya Ganguli; Ari S. Morcos. 2023. SemDeDup: Data-efficient learning at web-scale through semantic deduplication. arXiv:2303.09540v3.
references.support: Abstract and Section 3 directly describe pretrained embeddings, pairwise cosine similarity within clusters, and duplicate removal before training.
references.limitation: The exact raw-neighbor suppression claim is supported separately by the implementation, not inferred solely from the paper prose.

references.metadata: Facebook Research. 2023. SemDeDup official implementation, semdedup.py. File commit 6b4194511202c29b0e1ac8c730996777449ea2a4, 1 October 2023. Repository archived 1 November 2024.
claim_locations: Setup, nonnegative-threshold upper-triangle column maximum rule
Related work, fixed ordered suppression motivation
references.support: Pinned file lines 64-79 compute pairwise similarities, clear the diagonal, take torch.triu(diagonal=1), and take column maxima. Lines 149-152 remove columns with M > 1-eps. All earlier raw rows contribute regardless of whether they are removed. Nonnegative threshold qualification correctly accounts for zero padding.
references.correction: Replace bibliographic label [Meta/Facebook Research(2026)] and mutable main URL with [Facebook Research(2023)], explicit year 2023, and the immutable commit URL. Keep actual access date as a separate note; do not use it as publication year.
references.limitation: The fixed graph/order restriction is necessary: code lines 131-137 show random/easy ordering options. No general claim about refitted clusters is warranted. Downloaded main and pinned file are byte-identical (SHA256 9280d5feb84e6c65d2e24229db3ce8efc71a0ad585c41921539ccc3cc96cc293).

references.metadata: Todd J. Green; Grigoris Karvounarakis; Val Tannen. 2007. Provenance semirings. Proceedings of PODS, pages 31-40. DOI 10.1145/1265530.1265535.
claim_locations: Method, signed Boolean representation builds on provenance ideas
references.support: Abstract and Section 4 give polynomial-semiring provenance and evaluation under valuations; Theorem 4.3 is the positive-relational-algebra evaluation result.
references.correction: Optional completeness: expand PODS and add pages 31--40 and DOI. Do not use 61--70 (not the publisher record).
references.limitation: Green concerns positive relational algebra and N[X]; it does not itself establish this paper's signed negative-dependency formula. The current wording says building on established ideas, and the aggregate/difference source supplies the necessary nonmonotone antecedent.

references.metadata: Yael Amsterdamer; Daniel Deutch; Val Tannen. 2011. Provenance for aggregate queries. Proceedings of PODS, pages 153-164. DOI 10.1145/1989284.1989302.
claim_locations: Introduction, deletion-induced additions/nonmonotone queries and provenance
references.support: Sections 3-4 develop aggregation provenance. Section 5 studies difference; Example 5.3 on PDF pages 10-11 explicitly changes an annotation to zero and obtains a newly returned tuple. This directly supports deletion-induced additions as prior art.
references.correction: Optional completeness: expand PODS and add pages 153--164 and DOI.
references.limitation: Its difference semantics is explicitly distinct from signed-multiplicity semantics; do not identify the present Boolean expansion with the exact same semiring construction.

references.metadata: Mihai Budiu; Tej Chajed; Frank McSherry; Leonid Ryzhyk; Val Tannen. 2023. DBSP: Automatic incremental view maintenance for rich query languages. PVLDB 16(7):1601-1614. DOI 10.14778/3587136.3587137.
references.support: Publisher PDF page 1 reference format verifies all metadata. Abstract and introduction directly state incremental maintenance for full relational algebra, aggregation and nonmonotonic operations.
references.correction: No correction needed. Optional DOI may replace long PDF URL.

references.metadata: Sebastian Schelter. 2021. Towards efficient machine unlearning via incremental view maintenance. Workshop on Challenges in Deploying and Monitoring ML Systems at ICML 2021.
claim_locations: Related work, preprocessing/tokenization and sparse computational dependencies
references.support: PDF p.3 Section 2 explicitly includes tokenise/explode preprocessing and tokenize(e.text) Rust code in the maintained dataflow. Section 3 on that page explains sparse computational dependencies and the recomputation boundary. Abstract frames ML models as views.
references.correction: No correction needed. Section 2 locator can be added to tokenization clause if desired.
references.limitation: Web text search missed the tokenization paragraph; direct PDF extraction verified it. Do not remove this supported comparison.

references.metadata: Yinjun Wu; Val Tannen; Susan B. Davidson. 2020. PrIU: A provenance-based approach for incrementally updating regression models. SIGMOD, pages 447-462. DOI 10.1145/3318464.3380571.
references.support: Author PDF abstract and introduction support provenance-based incremental parameter updates after training-sample removals. Publisher-deposited Crossref metadata confirms page range 447-462, author order, title and year.
references.correction: No substantive correction needed. Optionally expand venue and add DOI.
references.limitation: Do not strengthen the present brief antecedent statement to universal exact retraining parity; source describes highly similar models in abstract.

references.metadata: Claude E. Shannon. 1959. Coding theorems for a discrete source with a fidelity criterion. IRE National Convention Record, volume 7, part 4, pages 142-163.
claim_locations: Related work, information-distortion arguments are classical
references.support: Reprinted primary text abstract and introduction define R(d), discuss allowable distortion, and give the source-rate/capacity tradeoff. Its first-page footnote identifies IRE International Convention Record vol.7, 1959.
references.correction: Change hyperlink label Original-paper scan to Reprinted text (or Author text, reprint); the supplied PDF is a collected-papers reprint with printed pp.325-350, not the original proceedings pagination. Add volume 7 if desired. Keep original 1959 citation; do not replace with Crossref reprint digitization year 2009.
references.limitation: IEEE page is bot-gated. Crossref DOI concerns the collected-papers digital chapter and does not independently supply original 142-163 pagination; original page range was not changed because no contradictory primary evidence was found.

retrieval_limits: SemDeDup PDF exceeded web fetch size; official arXiv full HTML was read instead.
Some ACM DOI landing pages were inaccessible; exact author full texts and publisher-deposited Crossref metadata were used.
Shannon reprint primary text was readable; IEEE landing page was bot-gated.
